stem:
Gopal folds a rectangular sheet once down the middle, presses a paint blot through both layers, then unfolds the sheet. The fold line is a line of symmetry for the action.

Which claim correctly predicts the unfolded design?

options.text: The unfolded sheet shows two blots mirror-symmetric about the fold line.
The fold line is the paint blot.
Two mirror blots appear even when the fold line is not treated as a line of symmetry.
The two blots are what create the fold line after unfolding.

teacher.key_rationale: Folding before the blot forces matching positions, so unfolding gives two blots symmetric about the fold line. Calling the fold line the blot swaps terms. Dropping symmetry omits the fold condition. Saying blots create the fold line reverses the relation.
